transactions.time_dependence: rate independent and positively homogeneous in de; no elapsed seconds or automatic resting decay
transactions.trial_commit_rollback: Each trial starts from committed state; no history accumulation across equilibrium guesses. Failed parent increment restores committed input.
transactions.events: Source resting erasure requires an explicit preparation/reset event; not an automatic zero-load side effect.
transactions.spin: Original objective stress/history rates require spin transport outside W=0; current executable profile omits spin consistently. Printed source spin-sign conflict remains outside scope.
transactions.tangent: Nonsmooth branch at projection=0 and sublinear history mobilisation near zero; no global smooth consistent tangent is implied.

source_parameter_scope.note: Input bounds are exploratory guards, not original-paper parameter recommendations. Other positive/friction/density conditions remain material/source-specific.

unsupported: proof of physical validity throughout the numerical1%history band

initialization_notes.numerical_admission: norm(h)<1.01R; rho capped at1, no projection. Not a physical admissibility claim.
